v1.4.0: 面向国内 AI 开发者补齐三大痛点分类——ai_models（hf-mirror / ModelScope 魔搭 / WiseModel / OpenI 启智）、python（pip 腾讯云/中科大/华为云、conda 清华、PyTorch wheels 清华；原 tools 中的 pip 清华与 pypi 阿里移至此处）、dev_registry（ghcr/quay/gcr/k8s/nvcr 的 DaoCloud 与南大镜像、阿里云 google_containers）。同时新增 llms.txt（AI 代理入口索引）、mcp_server/（零依赖 MCP Server）、docs/（数据看板页）。
新增 3 个分类共 16 个源（ai_models 4 / python 5 / dev_registry 7），另从 tools 迁移 2 个 pip 源至 python。全部初始 score 50（未实测），待 test_mirrors.sh 实测后回写。

新分类首轮实测校正：ModelScope API 路径 404 → 改用站点首页；OpenI 原 git.openi.org.cn 连接失败 → 改用平台规范域名 openi.pcl.ac.cn；清华 pytorch-wheels 路径已 404 → 替换为实测可达的阿里源并补上海交大备用；华为云 PyPI 对 curl 默认 UA 持续返回 429，为避免误判弃用已移除；新增 OpenXLab 浦源、BAAI 智源两个模型仓库。
Updated scores: 18 mirrors updated, 2 failed

v1.5.0: added read-only HTTP API (server/), service->mirror recipes (references/recipes.json, 25 services), crowd-report aggregation with median scoring (--aggregate / --network-label), and dependency-free selftest (scripts/selftest.py, wired into CI). Mirror data unchanged (121 sources).

v1.6.0: distribution + automation layer. Crowd contributions no longer need a fork or PR -- the '网络实测上报' GitHub Issue form is ingested automatically by scripts/ingest_report.py + .github/workflows/report-ingest.yml (whitelisted: rows reduced to {name,status,time_ms}, name must already exist in this database, so a report can move a known mirror's score but can never introduce a new URL). Added AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / .cursor/rules so any coding agent opening the repo is routed to the database. Added .github/workflows/pages.yml to publish docs/index.html. Selftest grew from 65 to 108 assertions (anti-poisoning, field minimisation, label sanitisation, doc-drift check). Mirror data unchanged (121 sources).

v1.7.0: contributor onboarding + change history + doc-drift guards. Added CONTRIBUTING.md (three contribution paths ordered by effort; the zero-git issue-report path first; the five contribution classes that are rejected), CHANGELOG.md (1.2.0 -> 1.7.0, extracted out of README so one history is not maintained in two places), and SECURITY.md (threat model: the whole risk of this project is a poisoned RECOMMENDATION, not code execution). Selftest gained section 8 (doc consistency: version / mirror-count / assertion-count across six current-state docs, plus CHANGELOG and server-README sample version) and a meta-assertion that does not count itself, so "assertions stated in docs == assertions actually run" is now enforced by CI. Also cleared 12 stale claims across 7 files. Mirror data unchanged (121 sources).

MCP transport drift. mcp_server/accel_mirror_mcp.py had reimplemented a weaker subset of the resolution logic: best_mirror only matched a bare category name, so best_mirror(service="pip") silently ignored the argument and answered "unknown category" -- while README and SKILL.md both claimed the HTTP API and the MCP server "share one set of rules". They did not. The MCP server now imports server/accel_mirror_api.py and reuses response_for_best / resolve_service / build_commands, so the two transports cannot diverge; selftest section 8 compares all 25 service names across both. Also: serverInfo.version was hardcoded to 1.4.0 while the database was at 1.7.0 -- it now reads the database version, removing another rot-prone constant. list_mirrors now accepts a service name as well as a category. Mirror data unchanged (121 sources).
